text:
Nina (Finance): Lumina Analytics opened a billing ticket: unusually high embed usage for 2026-06-12 05:00-06:00 UTC (~+95k). Asking for reconciliation and refund.
Tom (Eng-Infra): grabbing ledger slice now. Can you paste the extract you used?
Nina (Finance): ledger pull:
```
2026-06-12T05:00Z, 191200
2026-06-12T06:00Z, 12,300
```
Typical is ~95k/hr.
ops-bot: Deploy: proxy-edge v5.0 rolling restart eu-west-2 at 2026-06-12T04:59:57Z
Priya (Eng-SRE): logs show duplicate batches sent during restart; ingest reported duplicate-batch warnings. Example:
[2026-06-12T05:00:10Z] proxy-edge-7 INFO batch_id=lkj321 sent=2048
[2026-06-12T05:00:10Z] ingest-9 WARN batch_id=lkj321 duplicate
Priya (Eng-SRE): checksum unique rows = 95,600; ledger shows 191,200 -> 2x duplication detected.
Nina (Finance): overcount = 95,600 units. Contract rate = $0.0040/unit => $382.40.
Ava (Finance-Lead): provisionally approve up to $400. Need ops RCA and backfill confirmation before final credit.
Tom (Eng-Infra): RCA: graceful shutdown race in proxy v5.0 caused retries without idempotency. Patch submitted to enforce idempotency key and block resend on restart.
Priya (Eng-SRE): running dedupe backfill now; ETA ~1h. Will hold export for the affected window.
Zoe (Support): I'll tell customer we're investigating and will follow up with credit estimate.
Priya (Eng-SRE): backfill complete. Ledger corrected to 95,600 for that hour. Delta 95,600 units.
Nina (Finance): final memo: credit 95,600 units @ $0.0040 = $382.40. Draft to customer: "Duplicate ingestion during a proxy restart overstated embed usage between 05:00-05:04 UTC on 2026-06-12. We've reconciled the ledger and applied a $382.40 credit. Fix deployed to prevent recurrence."
Ava (Finance-Lead): signed off. Apply operational non-recurring credit, link INC-2026-811 in memo.
Nina (Finance): applied credit and notified Support to confirm with Lumina. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
